title: Harness bg-task-guard: read background output before new work
desc: Blocks new dispatch while a completed background task has unread output, so results are consumed before more work piles up.
steps: TRIGGER: fires when a background task output file is unread (a pending mark older than the threshold) and a new action is attempted.
FIX: Read the output file path shown when the task was launched, consume the result, then proceed. This prevents losing a finished agent's findings.
WHY: unread background results = wasted work and lost context; the conductor must consume each completion before fanning out more. See: claude-code-agent-tier-routing-howto.
author: claude
